images.title: The box with four numbers coming out
images.purpose: Put the hook question in front of the student without the answer: four numbers, 28, 36, 48 and 72, come out of a box that multiplies.
images.composition: A cardboard box in the middle with a teal arrow going in and a purple arrow coming out, four green number tags flying out to the right, a rabbit and a deer watching at the bottom left.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. A cardboard box seen from the front stands in the middle left of the frame. The box front is one rectangle, x 548 to 908 and y 450 to 690 (360 by 240 px), filled amber #E69F00 with a 4 px dark #2B2B2B outline; its open top is one dark #2B2B2B parallelogram from x 568 to x 928 at y 410 to 450, filled dark grey #6B7280. A teal #0072B2 curved arrow, 6 px thick with an arrowhead, starts at x 288 and y 380, arcs up and over and ends pointing down into the open top at x 660 and y 425 (the in arrow). A second curved arrow in reddish purple #CC79A7, 6 px thick with an arrowhead, starts at the open top at x 810 and y 420 and arcs up and to the right, ending at x 1000 and y 260 (the out arrow). Exactly 4 number tags are coming out of the box along the out arrow, each a rounded rectangle (corner radius 14 px) 150 by 90 px, filled green #009E73 with a thin dark outline and a white bold number (64 px): the tag 28 centred at x 960 and y 300; the tag 36 centred at x 1050 and y 170; the tag 72 centred at x 1190 and y 215; the tag 48 centred at x 1290 and y 345. The tags are the only numbers in the frame; each tag is tilted a few degrees as if flying. At the bottom left, standing on the ground line at y 760, a small flat rabbit (grey body, two long ears, about 150 px tall, centred at x 190) and next to it at x 330 a small flat deer (tan body, two small antlers, about 190 px tall); both look up at the box. No multiplier, no arrow label and no other text anywhere. Nothing else in the frame.

images.takeaway: Four numbers have come out of a box that multiplied each number that went in by a secret number.
images.description: A cardboard box with an arrow going in and an arrow coming out, four number tags 28, 36, 72 and 48 coming out, and a rabbit and a deer watching.
images.context: Hook image for Find the Hidden Numbers. It follows the picture at the start of the chapter in your maths book (a box with an arrow in, an arrow out and the numbers 28, 36, 48 and 72) and gives no multiplier and no answer.
images.teaching_notes: Let the student guess the secret number before anything is explained. The slip to watch is thinking there is only one possible secret number.

image_decisions.why: The box with the four numbers coming out puts the hook question in front of the student without giving the answer.
